verdicts.reason: A keeps the white frame layered on the halftone art and has a sensible left-to-right flow. Still, the two horizontal rules are stranded in the top-left corner, cut off at the canvas edge and detached from the headline. Stray tick marks float at x≈48 and near the right edge, and there is a large empty gap between the info column and the image. B is broken: the white frame has come off the artwork and sits as an empty box in the middle of the layout. The divider glyphs stick to the text ('GALLERY|', 'AU|'), the info lines are unevenly spaced, the headline wraps awkwardly to 'ART +' alone on one line, and a stray rule is left at the top-left edge.
